nodes.title: Staff review export (directive.2026-10-24.calling-first-build-all, integrator item 3): review.export {from, to, includeTest?, limit?} is staff-only (actor vp_success; no member role) and returns one workspace's calls in a window of at most 7 days as one JSON. Each call is call.get's own record (call.get and the export now share one builder, so they cannot drift): the transcript with every per-turn field the runtime stored (voice's coming per-turn trace travels with it unchanged), turns, moments, safety, judge marks, tools, hand-offs, outcomes, cost lines and settlement, analysis, the gate record, flags. Added: the runtime events seen (seq, type, time), an errors list (end reason error or failed, failed analysis, the safety judge unavailable, failed tools), and recording {available, why}, never an address or a signed link. Test calls are in by default (the owner reviews mostly on them). Time order; truncated is set past the limit (default 200, max 500). Each export is audited (vp_success, window, count).
nodes.rationale: The integrator's review script needs 'the log of everything' for the owner's long staging calls.
nodes.reverse_if: Staff need the recording itself (then add a short-lived signed link per call, audited), or a window's export outgrows one response (then page by cursor).
evidence: product/tests/calls-review-export.test.ts (synthetic): in-window calls in time order, test calls in and excludable, another workspace's and out-of-window calls never, errors listed, no recording address, audited; an owner is refused; more than 7 days refused in words

nodes.title: Integrator items 1-2 wait on peers: the call-page timeline (gap per turn, a marker where something went wrong, the recording seekable to the turn) needs voice's per-turn trace fields (not on the branch as of 2bdb29b); 'Flag this moment' calls learning's review.flag_turn {conversationId, turn, note}, agreed with learning 2026-10-24 (learning owns the tool and the owner_review flag; calls owns the button on call-review.tsx).
